package.name: f1tenth_depth_ingest_rs
package.description: Depth ingest node in Rust (rclrs): subscribes the ZED depth, camera_info, detection masks and detections once and publishes f1tenth_messages/DetectionDepthArray (detection_3d_node's per-detection medians) and DepthRoi (front_clearance_node's ROI pixels), depth_source:=ingest; plus a ROS-free C-ABI library of the same logic for f1tenth_perception's parity harness
